description: This file is a shell script that contains a series of tests for Git remote functionality, including remote addition, removal, renaming, setting URLs, fetching, updating, pruning, and other remote management operations.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository with a given branch and commits initial files.

methods.name: tokens_match
methods.description: Compares two strings token-by-token after sorting to verify they contain the same tokens.

methods.name: check_remote_track
methods.description: Checks if a remote is tracking specified branches.

methods.name: check_tracking_branch
methods.description: Verifies branches tracking a specific remote.

methods.name: get_url_test
methods.description: Tests the 'git remote get-url' command with various options.
